name: Zhejiang Chenfeng Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Chenfeng Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of lighting product structural components in China and internationally. It operates through Lighting Business and New Energy Business segments. The company offers LED lighting heat sink series, lighting printed circuit board series, lamp head series, and lighting metal parts series. It also provides LED bulb light radiators, lamp holders, lamp fittings and others, LED bulb PC covers, downlights, spotlights, and aluminum substrates.
